items.title: Modern Warfare 4 beta's first update is live, adding a new map, mode, and toned-down footsteps
items.description:
Infinity Ward has deployed the first proper update to the Modern Warfare 4 beta, addressing a chunk of the feedback from the beta's opening day, including footstep audio, weapon lethality, and map voting.

Read more

items.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker's console modes top out at 40fps, with no 60fps option at launch
items.description:
New console gameplay from developer Rebel Wolves and publisher Bandai Namco has confirmed The Blood of Dawnwalker won't offer a 60fps mode on PS5 or Xbox Series X/S when it launches next month

Read more

items.title: Silent Hill: Townfall's new gameplay trailer quietly confirms how long its PS5 exclusivity will last
items.description:
A new Silent Hill: Townfall gameplay trailer has offered up over 18 minutes of first-look footage while also quietly confirming exactly how long the game's PlayStation 5 exclusivity will last.

Read more

items.title: Is this the end of the GTA 6 leaks? Take-Two's legal crusade appears to shut down the hubs behind them
items.description:
UPDATE 3.30pm: Despite the CyberLeek website going dark, nope, the GTA 6 leaks haven't stopped.

Read more

items.title: Double Fine confirms it owns all its games' IP and publishing rights after Xbox split
items.description:
Double Fine has confirmed it owns – or will shortly own – the intellectual property and publishing rights to every game it made during its seven years under Xbox following the studio's split from Microsoft earlier this year.

Read more

items.title: Take-Two's legal action to find GTA 6 leaker begins, as it subpoenas Microsoft and Discord for any data "sufficient to identify the users person"
items.description:
The hunt for the GTA 6 leaker is on. Take-Two has reportedly filed multiple subpoenas in a federal district court to force information out of Microsoft and Discord related to anything - OneDrive data, Xbox accounts, or Discord users - that might reveal who leaked GTA 6 gameplay videos online.

Read more

items.title: The second season of Netflix's Cyberpunk Edgerunners anime releases this year
items.description:
The second season of Netflix anime Cyberpunk Edgerunners has a release date, and it's being released this year. We also have a new trailer giving us a peek at the 10-episode run.

Read more

items.title: That limited edition green see-through Xbox Series X reportedly costs as much as a PS5 Pro, and releases on Black Friday
items.description:
That fancy green see-through Xbox Series X - a limited edition creation for Xbox's 25th anniversary - reportedly releases on Black Friday and costs as much as a PS5 Pro.

Read more

items.title: Careful, the new Plague Tale game appears to have leaked a week ahead of launch
items.description:
Plague Tale fans beware: the new game, Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy, appears to have been cracked and shared online a week before release. It means spoilers may start appearing online, so be careful what you watch and read.

Read more

items.title: Connectivity issues force FromSoftware to close The Duskbloods network test early
items.description:
UPDATE 2PM BST: FormSoftware has closed today's The Duskbloods network test early due to connectivity issues.

Read more

items.title: Following rumoured talks, Guardians of the Galaxy's Dave Bautista has reportedly now signed as Kratos in Amazon's God of War
items.description:
The rumours appear to be true. Actor Dave Bautista - best known for his role as Drax the Destroyer in Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy series, and the Avengers films - has reportedly taken over as Kratos in Amazon's live-action God of War series.

Read more

items.title: Riot Games to end LoL fighting game 2XK0's development and issue refunds, less than a year since launch
items.description:
Active development on 2XKO - the free-to-play fighting game from Riot Games - will end in December. This comes not even a year after the game's full release in January, as the company doesn't see "a path toward sustainability".

Read more

items.title: Miyazaki suggests FromSoftware is keen to return to single-player games after The Duskbloods and Elden Ring: Nightreign
items.description:
Hidetaka Miyazaki, the president of FromSoftware and director of so many revered Soulsian games, has suggested the studio is keen to return to making single-player games after The Duskbloods.

Read more

items.title: IO Interactive announces new sales milestone for James Bond game 007 First Light
items.description:
The acclaimed James Bond game 007 First Light continues to find success, with developer IO Interactive announcing today it's passed 4 million sales since launch, just under three months ago.

Read more

items.title: No, The Duskbloods isn't releasing on 24th September, according to Nintendo
items.description:
Nintendo has denied that The Duskbloods will be releasing on the 24th September, after the date was included in an early preview of the game.

Read more

items.title: Final Fantasy: Crystal Chronicles composer speaks out about AI-generated Spotify album falsely using her name
items.description:
Final Fantasy: Crystal Chronicles composer Kumi Tanioka has spoken out about an album attributed to her on Spotify. The problem? She had nothing to do with it.

Read more

items.title: A cracked version of Marvel Tōkon is reigniting questions around DRM and its impact on PC games
items.description:
Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Soul is reigniting the debate around DRM, amid reports a new DRM-free cracked version is performing better than Sony's widely lambasted official PC version.

Read more

items.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta may have eradicated the annoying 'Compiling Shaders' wait PC players loathe
items.description:
While sharing the remaining details about the upcoming Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta scheduled for this weekend - such as pre-load information and PC specs - Infinity Ward and co-developer Beenox have revealed an unexpected PC gaming breakthrough. It's to do with eliminating elongated wait times associated with compiling a game's shaders.

Read more

items.title: Hardware spending in the US was so low in July that it nearly matched the 2020 pandemic days when everything was out of stock
items.description:
New data from the industry analysts at Circana has revealed that consumers are spending a lot less than usual on gaming hardware or the games themselves. Circana's latest report covers the US market in July, and it includes a lot of concerning data.

Read more

items.title: 15 minutes of Black Myth: Zhong Kui gameplay footage provide our first proper look at Wukong's successor yet
items.description:
Game Science has delivered a gift for anyone eager to see and hear more from Black Myth: Zhong Kui, the sequel to the incredibly successful Black Myth: Wukong. The developer released 15 chunky minutes of gameplay, giving us a first look at combat and a clearer picture of the protagonist, the Chinese mythological deity Zhong Kui.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 leaker shares footage suggesting link or access to playable build of the game, as Rockstar struggles to contain even more gameplay videos
items.description:
UPDATE 1PM BST: A previous version of this article erroneously suggested the leaker had "full access" to the GTA 6 game, based on the declaration of what appears to be an impersonating social media account.

Read more

items.title: The Duskbloods gameplay leaks ahead of tomorrow's closed beta, showing  tense PvP battles with guns, wolves, and velociraptors
items.description:
A snippet of gameplay from The Duskbloods - FromSoftware's Switch 2 PvPvE action game - has leaked online ahead of an upcoming closed beta test.

Read more

items.title: "I don't know if they will keep funding that one" - Former EA manager doesn't believe the next Mass Effect will survive Saudi takeover
items.description:
Inside and outside Electronic Arts, everyone is bracing for what's sure to be a very different company now that it's fully owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund. But the fate of one game in particular may be more perilous than any other: the next Mass Effect.

Read more

items.title: Third seemingly real GTA 6 video leaks as Rockstar scrambles to remove footage from the internet
items.description:
Another video of what appears to be legitimate Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay has leaked online, and again it bears the watermark of the group allegedly connected with today's earlier leaks, CyberLeek.

Read more

items.title: Horizon Hunters Gathering is reportedly no longer a live service game following negative feedback
items.description:
Horizon Hunters Gathering has reportedly been rebooted in order to ditch its live service elements, following negative feedback during early private playtests.

Read more

items.title: The next Binding of Isaac game is going up against Grand Theft Auto 6
items.description:
The Binding of Isaac: Repentance + Online has revealed a release date and it's one you probably have marked on your calendar. The package, a collection of The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth and all previously released add-ons, arrives 19th November on consoles -exactly the same day as Grand Theft Auto 6.

Read more

items.title: Stop Killing Games urges people not to support GTA 6 leakers, who declared "gamers' rights" their motive for action
items.description:
Consumer rights movement Stop Killing Games has released a public statement admonishing the actions of the group which took responsibility for leaking Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay footage overnight.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 gameplay footage and map appear to leak online, as group seemingly responsible makes demands of Rockstar
items.description:
What appears to be legitimate gameplay footage of Grand Theft Auto 6 has leaked onto the internet, alongside an alleged image of the game's entire map.

Read more

items.title: An updated PS5 DualSense Edge controller is apparently coming next year, but you probably shouldn't get get too excited
items.description:
The DualSense Edge, Sony's £200 / $200 pro-style controller for PlayStation 5 and PC, looks to be getting a revised model. That's according to filings on the website of US government agency the Federal Communications Commission (FCC).

Read more

items.title: Tekken 8 director jumps ship to join Harada's new Vs Studio team
items.description:
Kohei Ikeda, the game director of Tekken 8, has joined Katsuhiro Harada at recently formed and rival SNK developer Vs Studio.

Read more

items.title: Pokémon Center in the UK and Germany hit with the same data breach suffered by Valve's Steam hardware
items.description:
It appears the consequences of the recent CEVA Logistics data breach are wider than initially anticipated. Days after the company alerted Valve of the hack that affected Steam hardware customers in Europe, the shipping company has notified Pokémon Center that some of its customers are also affected. Pokémon Center is Pokemon's official merchandise and collectibles store.

Read more

items.title: Here's your next batch of Xbox and PC Game Pass games for August
items.description:
The next batch of Xbox and PC Game Pass games has been announced, detailing what's arriving in the latter part of August.

Read more

items.title: Don't boycott Grand Theft Auto 6, say workers fired by Rockstar - buy a T-shirt to help fund the legal battle instead
items.description:
The workers fired by Rockstar Games in an alleged 'union-busting' move last autumn have asked people concerned not to boycott the upcoming release of Grand Theft Auto 6.

Read more

items.title: Battlefield 6 is hosting a free trial, just in time for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's beta
items.description:
Battlefield 6's latest free trial kicks off today alongside Season 4's mid-season update, and while that mightn't be especially notable in itself, the timing is moreso: it coincides with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's highly anticipated, and stuffed, beta.

Read more

items.title: Resident Evil Requiem's Grace Ashcroft actor reportedly replacing Jennifer English as lead of lavish Chinese action game Tides of Annihilation
items.description:
Lavish Chinese action game Tides of Annihilation seems to have found a replacement for Jennifer English, the award-winning actor who withdrew from voicing the game's main character Gwendolyn last month. And the replacement appears to be Angela Sant'Albano, who performed Grace Ashcroft in Resident Evil Requiem.

Read more

items.title: Be warned: Fallout 4's next update may break your mods - and there's a similar one for Skyrim in the works, too
items.description:
For most games, the news of a new patch is usually received with excitement. This is true for games made by Bethesda too, of course, but not when they're as old as Fallout 4 and Skyrim are. The reason? Mods.

Read more

items.title: 20-year-old Gunz the Duel gets Steam re-release, receives harsh criticism over network issues and suspected use of generative AI
items.description:
Gunz the Duel, the cult classic 3rd-person action game first released back in 2006, is back on Steam. But the long-awaited return of the genre-defining game has been tarred somewhat by technical issues, and allegations of AI usage.

Read more

items.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, a remake of the first game, is getting RPG skill trees, crafting mechanics and a 'focus meter'
items.description:
Amazon Game Studios and Crystal Dynamics have released a new trailer for Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis. It's the sixth instalment in a series of 'behind-the-scenes' videos chronicling the making of the upcoming remake, which is being developed by Flying Wild Hog. This latest video shows us some previously unknown elements of the game, and they mark a pretty big departure from the original 1996 title.

Read more

items.title: "I'm pretty sure I mean it" - Legendary game developer Warren Spector announces retirement
items.description:
Warren Spector, the legendary game developer known for being a key part in the development of the Deus Ex series as well as his role in Epic Mickey, Ultima, and System Shock, has announced his retirement.

Read more

items.title: Shuhei Yoshida told Expedition 33 studio to avoid terms like 'turn-based RPG' because it may cause people to "overlook" the game
items.description:
One of the reasons Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 stood out so much in early footage was how action-packed its combat looked, despite being a turn-based RPG. But while developer Sandfall Interactive has described the game as a turn-based RPG - and reinvigorated the genre, to some degree - not everyone was happy with that approach.

Read more

items.title: Long-awaited Switch 2 version of Diablo 4 reportedly releases days after BlizzCon, and includes both game expansions
items.description:
The much-rumoured Switch 2 version of Diablo 4 apparently includes both expansions of the action role-playing game - Vessel of Hatred and Lord of Hatred - all in one Age of Hatred Collection. And it's reportedly being released 15th September.

Read more

items.title: Sony still hasn't chosen a PlayStation 6 release date, says CEO, as RAM crisis continues
items.description:
We already know that console manufacturing is being heavily impacted by the on-going component shortage, driven by the proliferation of AI datacenters, the war in Iran, and accusations of price fixing. It turns out that these factors are putting so much pressure on console manufacturers that Sony hasn't even got a release date for the PlayStation 6 internally.

Read more

items.title: Spider-Man is looking exceptionally strong in Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls
items.description:
Since its release, people have been throwing themselves at Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls. Much debate has been had around who are the strongest characters in the base roster, but now that the game's first big tournament has concluded, we may have an early answer.

Read more

items.title: Call of Duty now has a guide on how to enable its convoluted security features so you can play the Modern Warfare 4 beta on PC
items.description:
As we approach the first weekend of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta, Activision's Ricochet anti-cheat team has published a detailed guide to help PC players turn on certain security features that are necessary to play online.

Read more

items.title: Call of Duty studio Sledgehammer reportedly worked on a Halo multiplayer prototype before it got canned
items.description:
A Halo game made by an Activision studio doesn't sound like a far-fetched idea, and is actually something Xbox considered per a new report. Sledgehammer Games, the studio behind several Call of Duty games like WW2, Vanguard, and Modern Warfare 3, is said to have been sought out to develop a Halo multiplayer game.

Read more

items.title: Gameplay footage for the cancelled Star Wars: Magellan has appeared online
items.description:
Years after its cancellation, gameplay footage for Star Wars: Magellan, the action RPG developed by the now-shuttered Echtra Games, has appeared online.

Read more

items.title: Heroes and Until Dawn star Hayden Panettiere dies aged 36
items.description:
Hayden Panettiere - the actor who shot to fame as the cheerleader in TV superhero show Heroes - has died aged 36.

Read more

items.title: Fortnite is getting a collaboration with a game made in Roblox, months after Epic boss Tim Sweeney referred to the rival platform as a force that could "grow and eat gaming"
items.description:
It looks like Fortnite is getting a crossover with a game made in Roblox. In the latest upcoming season of the game - named Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4: Override - the world's biggest battle royale introduces a wealth of gaming properties to its world. Developer Epic's first trailer for the new season (below) shows off a slew of gaming characters from all eras: you've got Crash Bandicoot, Sonic the Hedgehog and his pal Tails, Joker from Persona 5, Mega Man, Kitana and Scorpion from Mortal Kombat, and more.

Read more

items.title: For the first time ever in a Call of Duty beta, the Modern Warfare 4 beta includes a campaign mission
items.description:
Activision has announced several new details about the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta, whose first leg is set to kick off Friday. The official Call of Duty X account posted a dense image showing all content players have access to, and it's certainly more than many expected.

Read more

items.title: Saber Interactive finally adds an AI disclaimer to Rideshare Stimulator's Steam page
items.description:
Amid the row between Saber Interactive CEO Matthew Karch and former writer Stella Sacco after he said he'd have "been happy to replace" her with AI, the studio has finally added the AI disclaimer to Rideshare Stimulator's Steam page that had been conspicuously missing since the game first went live for wishlisting on 30th July.

Read more

items.title: Matthew McConaughey explains why he turned down the role of Joel in The Last of Us
items.description:
Matthew McConaughey has explained why he ultimately passed on playing Joel in HBO's The Last of Us – a role that, of course, went to Pedro Pascal instead.

Read more
category: The Last of Us Part II

items.title: Kingdom Hearts creator Tetsuya Nomura teases his role in the new anime series, tells fans to "let your imagination run wild"
items.description:
Kingdom Hearts creator Tetsuya Nomura has addressed the newly announced Kingdom Hearts anime series directly for the first time, though he's giving away very little.

Read more

items.title: Halloween: The Game will get a digital release in New Zealand after all
items.description:
Halloween: The Game will get a digital release in New Zealand after all, despite initially being lumped in with Australia's classification refusal.

Read more

items.title: Saber CEO Matthew Karch apologises to writer he said he'd have "been happy to replace" with AI
items.description:
Saber Interactive CEO Matthew Karch has apologised to Stella Sacco, the writer at the centre of the Rideshare Stimulator AI controversy, after publicly saying he'd have been "happy to replace her with AI".

Read more

items.title: Simpsons creator Matt Groening seemingly lets slip that Hit & Run is coming back
items.description:
Simpsons creator Matt Groening may have just let slip that a Hit & Run comeback is on the way.

Read more

items.title: Killing PlayStation discs could make PS Store games cheaper, according to a former Square Enix exec
items.description:
A former Square Enix exec believes that PS Store prices could actually come down as a result of Sony's decision to end all physical media on PlayStation.

Read more

items.title: Kingdom Hearts 4's first new world is inspired by Pixar's Coco
items.description:
Alongside its Kingdom Hearts 4 release window and its Kingdom Hearts anime series announcement, Disney used Friday's D23 Entertainment Showcase to confirm the first new world for Kingdom Hearts 4: one inspired by Pixar's Coco.

Read more

items.title: Kingdom Hearts is getting its own anime series on Disney+ and Disney Channel
items.description:
A Kingdom Hearts animated show is on the way.

Read more

items.title: Kingdom Hearts 4 finally has a release window, if not quite a firm release date
items.description:
Kingdom Hearts 4 finally has a release window – late 2027.

Read more

items.title: UK video game industry charity football match raises over £63,000 for physically disabled gamers
items.description:
Video game charity SpecialEffect has once again hosted its One Big Game football event, bringing developers from all across the UK games industry together to raise money for a good cause. And with the event now over, more than £63,000 has been raised to help support physically disabled gamers.

Read more

items.title: Compulsion Games becomes publisher of South of Midnight on Steam, suggesting departure from Xbox amid major restructuring is now complete
items.description:
Developer Compulsion Games is now listed as the publisher of its beautiful, musical action adventure game South of Midnight on Steam, suggesting that its full detachment from the Xbox division is complete.

Read more

items.title: Nintendo announces Pokémon Pokopia has sold over 5m copies, meaning that roughly one in four Switch 2 users now owns the game
items.description:
It looks like we've got another massive Pokémon-flavoured hit on our hands. Nintendo and The Pokémon Company have confirmed that Pokémon Pokopia has sold more than five million units globally - a pretty impressive number given the game has been out for "just over four months". These sales include both physical and digital editions of the game.

Read more

items.title: EA Sports FC might be getting a proper football game challenger, as 2K sets up new studio to make its "next blockbuster sports franchise"
items.description:
EA's relatively uncontested football crown may be seriously challenged again, as 2K Sports announces a brand new studio led by a former FIFA executive producer that's mandated to create the company's "next blockbuster sports franchise".

Read more

items.title: Netflix's gaming "secret weapon" is no more - Oxenfree studio Night School is to close
items.description:
The hope that Netflix might produce something more than snackable sports or party games has vanished with today's revelation that Oxenfree studio Night School is to close.

Read more

items.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved studio outlines five key updates that'll drop with next week's big patch
items.description:
There's a new update coming to Halo: Campaign Evolved next week. The patch, which is targeting some of the biggest issues players have had with the game since its launch a few weeks ago, will arrive sometime between 17th August and 21st August (no fixed date has been announced yet).

Read more

items.title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls looks to have sold almost half a million copies in a week
items.description:
New sales estimates show that Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls may have sold almost 500,000 copies in around a week, a solid pace for a fighting game.

Read more

items.title: Marvel's Wolverine "fully playable" on disc when it releases, Insomniac clarifies, perhaps making it one of the last few PlayStation games that will be
items.description:
Marvel's Wolverine developer Insomniac has clarified the game will be "fully playable" on disc when it releases for PlayStation 5 on 15th September. It won't, in other words, be a disc-in-a-box that still requires you to download the game in order to play. This may make it one of PlayStation's last fully disc-based games.

Read more

items.title: You have fewer than 200 days to migrate all your old Pokémon from Pokémon Bank to Pokémon Home, or they're gone forever
items.description:
Today, The Pokémon Company announced that it's shutting down Pokémon Bank, the Pokémon storage app was that was originally released for the Nintendo 3DS back in 2013. The service goes offline on 26th February, 2027, so you've still got plenty of time to access your old pals and begin migrating them into your new games, if you've got the time and energy.

Read more

items.title: After this week's Elder Scrolls 6 tease, fans think they've figured out its full name - and it was hidden in Starfield all along
items.description:
Following Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's recent redacted tease of a subtitle for the long-awaited Elder Scrolls 6, it's been discovered the game's full name might have been hiding in developer Bethesda's most recent release, Starfield, all along.

Read more

items.title: Bethesda finally "looking into" patching Oblivion Remastered on PC, PS5 and Xbox amid praise for Switch 2 release
items.description:
The Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion Remastered arrived on Switch 2 earlier this week, immediately drawing praise for its well-optimised state. This is actually a bit of a problem - not because of how it runs on Switch 2, but rather because of how it continues to run on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X/S.

Read more
category: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered

items.title: 'I would frankly have been happy to replace her with AI' - extraordinary public spat between Saber CEO and writer "replaced with ChatGPT" intensifies
items.description:
A public spat between Saber Interactive - creator of Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, the upcoming Suntman: Hollywood game and many others - and a former employee who claims she was "replaced" by ChatGPT has erupted over the past few days, and in the wake of new statements from either side has continued to intensify.

Read more

items.title: "The most offensive thing we see every time we boot up the game" Halo co-creator takes shots at Campaign Evolved art direction
items.description:
It's been an interesting launch period for Halo: Campaign Evolved. Despite reviewing well, the game has failed to sell particularly well on PS5, where the low-effort Black Ops 1 and 2 ports seemingly outsold the Microsoft title 16-to-1. After the game shipped, multiple contract positions were terminated, and players have been taking umbrage with some of the mechanical and artistic changes to the game.

Read more

items.title: Twitch is training AI on livestreams, says it's an opt out feature as "nobody would opt in"
items.description:
Twitch - the popular gaming and IRL streaming platform - has announced it'll start training generative AI models on those livestreaming on the platform.

Read more

items.title: Stop Killing Games backs Dutch consumer rights lawsuit against Sony's PlayStation digital store "monopoly"
items.description:
Stop Killing Games, the grassroots initiative fighting to prevent game publishers from shutting down servers without offering an alternative, has joined a lawsuit filed in the Netherlands against Sony for its alleged monopoly of selling digital games on the PlayStation Store (via GamesRadar).

Read more

items.title: Immortality creator Sam Barlow's new video-scouring game is sci-fi horror Precognition, a collab with filmmaker Brandon Cronenberg, in which you see and change the future
items.description:
The new game from Her Story and Immortality maker Sam Barlow - and his studio Half Mermaid - has a name: it's called Precognition. It's a sci-fi horror and it's releasing in spring 2028, as one of the debut games from Phasmophobia company Kinetic's new publishing label.

Read more

items.title: Dawn of War 4 gets a release date delay to "further refine the experience ahead of launch"
items.description:
Dawn of War 4 has been delayed to the tail-end of this year, so the developers at King Art games can "further refine the experience ahead of launch."

Read more

items.title: The "untranslatable" book that inspired Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 has been translated, and you can buy it later this year
items.description:
The first ever English translation of Alain Damasio’s Horde of the Counterwind (or, to give the book its original name La Horde du Contrevent) is going on sale later this year. The novel, a cult classic that is cited as one of the driving inspirations behind the acclaimed and best-selling Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, will be available in hardback on 13th October, 2026 via Abrams Books in the US. The UK date seems to be listed as 12th November on Amazon; we have contacted the publisher for clarification.

Read more

items.title: Multiplayer Witcher spin-off Project Sirius hit by layoffs again, in "broader shift in development strategy" at CD Projekt Red
items.description:
UPDATE 12TH AUGUST 5.20PM: CD Projekt Red has confirmed the layoffs to Eurogamer.

Read more

items.title: Ghost of Yōtei: Complete Edition is coming to PS5 later this year, with new story additions, a new roguelike survival mode, and more
items.description:
Sony and PlayStation have just announced Ghost of Yōtei: Complete Edition, a new version of 2025's open world action game, launching with additional content that wasn't in the first release. It launches for PS5 on 1st October, 2026.

Read more

items.title: Crimson Desert getting a Switch 2 release, and Pearl Abyss sees "significant potential" for multiplayer, with "live service operation models" mentioned
items.description:
Crimson Desert developer Pearl Abyss has confirmed a Switch 2 version of the game will be released, and given a rough timeframe for it, and said it sees "significant potential" for multiplayer in the single-player open-world fantasy game.

Read more

items.title: Out of nowhere, Sony confirms that 2024 breakout hit Helldivers 2 joins PlayStation Plus Extra and Premium today
items.description:
Load your rifles and get ready to deliver some democracy to those heathen alien interlopers, because Helldivers 2 comes to PlayStation Plus today. Sony Interactive Entertainment announced that the game will be added to the roster of titles PS Plus Extra and Premium subscribers can access as part of its August 2026 update (sorry, Essential-tier subs). The game, developed by Arrowhead Studios, launched back in 2024 and has netted a decent 20 million sales since then.

Read more

items.title: Meccha Chameleon has now sold 20 million copies in two months
items.description:
Meccha Chameleon, the indie hide-and-seek game that launched on Steam two months ago, has cemented itself as one of the year's biggest hits. The game's developer posted a sales milestone update today, announcing that sales have surpassed a staggering 20 million copies.

Read more

items.title: Smilegate will rescue Lost Ark's western servers, as Amazon ditches support while retreating from MMO development
items.description:
Amazon Game Studios has announced it will no longer support the Western game servers for massively-multiplayer online action role-playing game Lost Ark, from 2027 onwards.

Read more

items.title: Xbox promises that the causes of the recent outage, which rendered even game discs unplayable, have been fixed
items.description:
Xbox says it has fixed the issue at the heart of the major service outage suffered in July. Chief technical officer Scott Van Vliet, who initially offered an explanation as to why so many services were affected, promised to investigate further at the time, and he has now returned with an update.

Read more

items.title: A forgotten old co-op Lord of the Rings game has been unexpectedly remastered and re-released, and there's a promise of more to come
items.description:
Aspyr has unexpectedly remastered and re-released an old Lord of the Rings action role-playing game, which was notable for having three-player co-op and parallel story about one of Sauron's powerful servants doing naughty things up north.

Read more
category: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North

items.title: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's internal playthrough of The Elder Scrolls 6 disrupted by a giant inflatable rat, as Bethesda union protests cuts
items.description:
An early internal preview of The Elder Scrolls 6 by Xbox CEO Asha Sharma was met by a giant inflatable rat, looming over the Bethesda offices in Rockville, Maryland.

Read more

items.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved struggles to sell in anywhere near the quantities the recent Black Ops revivals did, and the probable reason? Lack of multiplayer
items.description:
Halo: Campaign Evolved - the remake of the original Halo 1 campaign and the first Halo game released on PlayStation - has struggled to sell in meaningful quantities, and the probable reason for it? A lack of multiplayer.

Read more

items.title: Much-wishlisted 100-player shooter Wardogs gets an early access release date, invites anyone unhappy with the closed beta to claim a refund
items.description:
Wardogs, the ambitious shooter from Battalion 1944 and The Turing Test developer Bulkhead, will soon arrive on Steam early access. The studio announced today, after months of invite-only tests, Wardogs will finally be released on 10th September.

Read more

items.title: "We live in a world full of AI, let's be honest with ourselves" - 1666: Amsterdam developer still using AI tools despite recent controversy
items.description:
Canadian developer Panache Digital, co-founded by Assassin's Creed creator Patrice Désilets, has said it is still using AI tools to help develop its witchy action game 1666: Amsterdam, albeit "less and less".

Read more

items.title: Until Dawn and Little Nightmares 3 studio Supermassive announces further layoffs, with as many as 75 people expected to lose their jobs
items.description:
Supermassive - the UK studio best known for its cinematic horror games including Until Dawn, The Quarry, and the Dark Pictures Anthology series - has announced more layoffs, this time affecting as many as 75 employees.

Read more

items.title: Gears of War E-Day is at the centre of a heated movement debate, as players new and old are torn on wall-bouncing
items.description:
The first stage of Gears of War E-Day's beta may have concluded, but that hasn't stopped discussion around the game from continuing to rage online. This time, it's an old favourite: is movement in Gears of War: E-Day good? Does leaping between cover with a shotgun in-hand scare off the normals? Is it… "sweaty"?

Read more

items.title: After a slow start, Alan Wake 2 is finally doing the numbers for Remedy and has hit another major milestone
items.description:
Remedy Entertainment has revealed updated sales data for Alan Wake 2, which has now exceeded 3 million copies.

Read more

items.title: GTA 6 might not cost $100, but most of the people pre-ordering it are buying it at that price, Take-Two reveals
items.description:
Though many may baulk at the idea of paying $100 (£90) for a game, a lot of the people who pre-ordered Grand Theft Auto 6 bought the more expensive Ultimate edition rather than the $80 (£70) Standard edition. That's according to Strauss Zelnick, CEO of Rockstar parent company Take-Two.

Read more

items.title: Big Walk strides to sales success, passing an impressive milestone in under one week
items.description:
Developer House House's collaborative puzzle-solving and hangout game par excellence, Big Walk, has found encouraging commercial success. Publisher Panic announced on Bluesky that it's already passed 1m sales.

Read more

items.title: Marvel Tōkon's dire PC performance improved massively by new patch, drastically reducing CPU use and stutters
items.description:
Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls has struggled with some serious technical problems on PC ever since its release last week, resulting in a disparity between console owners and desktop diehards. Thankfully, a new patch seems to have swooped in to the rescue.

Read more

items.title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 just had its biggest sales boost in years thanks to Brand New Day
items.description:
In yet another example of a successful film or TV show raising the profile of a related game, Hollywood blockbuster Spider-Man: Brand New Day has brought new players to the years-old Marvel's Spider-Man 2 game.

Read more

items.title: Assassin's Creed creator's dark and witchy action game 1666: Amsterdam is out in early access sooner than we expected
items.description:
1666: Amsterdam, a game that's survived years of legal battles between Assassin's Creed creator Patrice Désilets and Ubisoft, has an early access release date. It'll be released 25th August for PC, on Steam and the Epic Games Store.

Read more

items.title: "They don't understand art" - id Software lead slams Xbox, says it's "impossible" to make games like 2016's Doom now
items.description:
A lead developer at id Software has spoken out about Microsoft's decision to make major cuts at the developer, and has said it's "impossible" to make triple-A games like 2016's Doom with half the staff.

Read more

items.title: As developer Arc System Works promises a fix, Marvel Tōkon's suffering PC players are creating some bizarre home remedies for its dire performance woes
items.description:
Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls has been out for a few days now, and the PC version appears a little busted. Wide-ranging reports, including stuttering, online matchmaking issues, and CPU strain, are plaguing Windows warriors who have joined during the game's opening week.

Read more

items.title: Sean Murray suggests No Man's Sky follow-up Light No Fire is quite far along, but he's 'learned a very important lesson' about speaking too soon
items.description:
It's a big moment for No Man's Sky. This week sees developer Hello Games' exploratory space sim celebrating its tenth anniversary, and to mark the occasion, I recently spoke with studio boss Sean Murray.
